newsitem.title: UK: UK says would clear EWS buy of Railfreight.
newsitem.headline: UK says would clear EWS buy of Railfreight.

text.p: Britain's Department of Trade and Industry said on Wednesday it would not expect to refer for monopolies investigation any purchase by English, Welsh and Scottish Railway Holding Ltd (EWS) of Railfreight Distribution (RfD), one of the last remaining British train operating companies due for privatisation.
EWS is one of a number of parties interested in buying RfD, whose business includes international cargo train operations through the Channel Tunnel. Sale negotiations are under way.

The EWS group, part-owned by U.S. rail freight operator Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp, already owns Britain's three main bulk freight operators and runs the national mail and parcel distribution company.
The only other significant rail-borne freight operator is container specialist Freightliner, which is owned by a venture capital-backed management group.
Industry sources say Freightliner, in conjunction with passenger operator Stagecoach Holdings Plc, is one of the other companies interested in acquiring RfD.
